name: Uploader Bot
description: Telegram downloader bot for DiskWala, Terabox and YouTube.

TERABOX_COOKIES.description: Terabox cookie(s), comma-separated. Needed for the built-in Terabox resolver.

YTDL_API_KEY.description: Optional key for the existing YouTube download resolver.

MAX_FILE_MB.description: Maximum file size in MB staged and uploaded by the bot.

ALLOWED_USERS.description: Optional comma-separated Telegram user/chat IDs. If empty, first /start claims the bot.

DISKWALA_PROXY_URL.description: Optional SESSION-free DiskWala resolver endpoint (POST JSON URL).

DISKWALA_API_KEY.description: API key for DISKWALA_PROXY_URL. Store as a deployment secret.
